title: Technical Basics and Clinical Benefits of Photon-Counting CT

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Technical Basics and Clinical Benefits of Photon-Counting CT》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Novel photon-counting detector CT (PCD-CT) has the potential to address the limitations of previous CT systems, such as insufficient spatial resolution, limited accuracy in detecting small low-contrast structures, or missing routine availability of spectral information.
